description: Flexible variants: Add Float3 (typed + token), Multiply Float * Float3 through a connection, Subtract Float2 tokens, Divide Float4 / Float, EqualTo Float3, Compose / Decompose, Invert Float2, Select String (tokens), ConditionallyStore Hash, PreviousFrameValue Float3, Prim constants and a node newer than the runtime (skipped). Upstream quirks kept on purpose: a '[1, 2]' token parses as (0, 0) (parseVector only skips '('); an Any state left unauthored resolves to Float, so hashLoose falls back to the first (Float) variant and reads '0xCAFEBABE' as a hex float; relationship-valued Any inputs (primPick) never resolve to Prim.
